regions.today: Dry at first in many areas. However, during the afternoon rain will spread from the south across the province. The rain will persist into the evening. Light westerly breezes and afternoon temperatures of 7 to 9 degrees.
regions.tonight: Continuing cloudy with rain persisting tonight, becoming lighter and patchier by morning. Lowest temperatures of 5 to 8 degrees in mainly light northerly or variable breezes, fresher near southern coasts.
regions.tomorrow: The last of the rain should clear tomorrow morning. Some hazy sunny spells developing later in the afternoon. Highest temperatures of 7 to 10 degrees in light variable breezes.
